Description
Victoria University of Wellington is based in one of the safest and most liveable cities in the world—Wellington, the vibrant capital city of New Zealand. The University comprises three central-city campuses and provides world-class education and a study experience to remember.
The University regularly features at the top of international rankings and its outstanding research has received national and international recognition.
The University is a global–civic university offering nearly 200 undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD programmes in a variety of academic areas. Leadership programmes enhance our students’ degrees, and our dedicated international office provides students with a range of services.
